name: Mastok Wrilehiss
summary: At Splintertree Post, Mastok Wrilehiss works to hold the Horde’s ground in Ashenvale. He directs scouts and warriors to watch nearby borders and face corrupting elemental forces amid the night elves’ hostility.

sections.title: A Bulwark in the Ancient Woods
sections.body: Splintertree Post lies beneath Ashenvale’s canopy, surrounded by hostile night elf territory. Mastok Wrilehiss helps defend the outpost and watches its supply routes and the forest beyond. The Sentinels see the settlement as an intrusion on their lands. They strike quickly when they sense weakness.

sections.title: Coordinating the Front
sections.body: From inside the stockade, Mastok Wrilehiss gives passing adventurers duties in the Horde’s defense. He watches the borders toward the Stonetalon Mountains and sends scouts to speak with shamans such as Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring at Zoram'gar Strand. He also follows the strange corruption afflicting local elementals.

faq.answer: Mastok Wrilehiss is an orc officer at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. He helps defend the outpost against night elf attacks and investigates threats in the region.

faq.q: Where can Mastok Wrilehiss be found?
faq.answer: You can find Mastok Wrilehiss inside Splintertree Post, a fortified Horde outpost in east-central Ashenvale along the main forest road.

faq.q: What tasks does Mastok assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Mastok assigns Horde adventurers to investigate corrupted elementals, secure routes toward Stonetalon, and carry messages to Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.

faq.q: Why is Splintertree Post under constant pressure?
aliases: why are night elves attacking splintertree
faq.answer: Splintertree Post is a Horde logging hub and stronghold in Ashenvale. The night elves see the orcs’ presence and timber harvest as a desecration of sacred lands, so skirmishes continue.

faq.q: Why does Mastok send travelers to Je'neu Sancrea?
faq.answer: Mastok sends travelers to Je'neu Sancrea because the Earthen Ring shamans study and heal Ashenvale’s elemental instability. Their knowledge may help address tainted water elementals and strange disturbances.

faq.q: Is Mastok Wrilehiss hostile to Alliance players?
faq.answer: Yes. Mastok is a Horde officer who defends Splintertree Post. He attacks Alliance members who approach the encampment.

angles.text: As a Horde champion, you can turn to Mastok for duties that help hold the Horde’s frontier in Ashenvale.
Mastok represents the orc military presence in Ashenvale and defends Splintertree Post against night elf Sentinels.
As a shaman, Mastok may send you to seek the Earthen Ring’s guidance at Zoram'gar Strand about corrupted elementals.
